part_a: Part A. In this part, you will hear short conversations between two people. After each conversation, a narrator will ask a question about what was said. You will hear each conversation and question only once. Choose the best answer from the four options in front of you.
part_b: Part B. In this part, you will hear longer conversations. After each conversation, you will hear several questions. Listen carefully, because each conversation and question will be spoken only once. Choose the best answer for each question.
part_c: Part C. In this part, you will hear several short talks, similar to classroom lectures. After each talk, you will hear some questions. The talks and questions will not be repeated. Choose the best answer for each question.
